notes.title: Update Version 0.2 is here!
notes.content:
Hello Guests, 
 In this update there will be one new level, for a total of 4 levels. The big red doors is how to progress to the next level. There are also a few other things changed.

Whats updated?

1) 1 new level.
2) Fewer Inventory slots and toolbelt slots( Prep for Backpack System)
3) Health no longer auto regenerates, you must eat food to gain back lost healthːsteammockingː
4) Took out melee weapons (Axe,Bone club).
5) Redesigned levels

notes.title: Update comming SOON!
notes.content:
Hello hotel guests!
  There will be a update SOON! This update will be a smaller update, and the following update will be focused on more levels. There are currently 3 levels in the game, so the level 3 exit is not broken =). Hope you enjoy and as always thanks for the support, and keep the feedback comming! If leaving negative feed back please express your concerns so they can get addressed.
